changes: Fix missing Three.js BufferGeometryUtils module that prevented the scene loading.
Bundle all transitive Three.js addon dependencies instead of just three selected files.
Add automatic static ES module import-graph checks to catch missing browser modules.
Strengthen deployment verification to check module URLs before marking a release live.
Create SOLVI.help open-world Three.js and WebXR foundation.
Add rigged animated character with Idle, Walking, Running and Waving actions.
Add autonomous roaming, floor navigation, cubes and movement controls.
Add versioned deployment watcher, dev-log overlay and server verification.
Scaffold Flask WebSockets, shared presence and opt-in WebRTC media.
